mustFix.problem: The page has no photography at all; concept promised a hero photo under the gable; a homeowner never sees a real room or install
mustFix.fix: Place >= 3 approved niche-library frames with [[img]]: hero frame clipped by the gable polygon, one beam-wall/living frame in #living, one kids or garage frame; warm grade, no faces, honest alt text

elevate.move: Make photography part of the plan: each room tag opens on a real frame of that room clipped by its plan outline with the strap tick on the tall piece, so the drawing becomes the photo as you enter each room

Let Fraunces be the house's signage: room names set huge at opsz 144 running along the plan's dimension lines, with the decorative italic accents and caps-label noise stripped so one scale contrast carries the page
